Type: footed stoneware plant pot
Use: holding an indoor plant; on the floor or a table in a living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, bohemian, contemporary
Materials: glazed speckled stoneware, raw clay lines and rim
Colors: warm coral pink, sandy beige
Shape: tall straight cylinder with a diagonal windowpane grid, small feet, medium-large, sturdy
Feel: playful, warm, crafted
Goes with: light wood, white walls, terracotta and green; mid-century or boho rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Large Windowpane Footed Stoneware Planter, 9.25"H, Arabesque
product.description: This beautiful arabesque-colored planter with a large hand-stenciled pattern will brighten any room. Slight variations from one pot to the next truly make each pot unique. Durable and easily cleaned, this large planter will hold lovely spring blooms—or whatever else you want to plant! 9" diameter x 9.25"H; 8.25" interior diameter Made of ceramic stoneware for durability Equipped with a drainage hole, this pot is suitable for direct or indirect planting. Criss-cross pattern is applied by hand to create a one-of-a-kind look. No assembly required Hand wash with a damp cloth.
